African Vaccine Manufacturing: Procurement Commitments, Regulatory Readiness and Investment

A vaccine factory needs more than a production line and a public-health rationale. It needs a product that can be supplied to its intended market, buyers able to place and fund orders, and the capability to deliver quality-assured doses repeatedly. Africa's emerging procurement arrangements make those requirements more visible, while exposing the distance between an invitation to compete and dependable manufacturing revenue.
